content.value_statement: Documentation teams need clear product help that users can follow without support. This skill structures onboarding guides, how-to articles, tutorials, and FAQs for end users.
actual_capabilities: Drafts quick-start guides with account setup, profile setup, and first project steps.
Creates task-focused how-to guides with prerequisites, steps, troubleshooting, and related links.
Organizes FAQs into clear sections for account, billing, features, and technical questions.
Builds learning tutorials with goals, time estimates, prerequisites, and screenshot placeholders.
Suggests a documentation folder structure for guides, tutorials, FAQs, and image assets.
limitations: It does not capture or verify real screenshots from your product.
It cannot confirm product flows unless you provide current UI details.
Its examples use placeholder product names and should be customized.
It does not replace user testing or accessibility review.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Feature Guide
use_cases.description: Create a user-facing guide that explains setup, first use, next steps, and support options.

use_cases.title: Improve Support Deflection
use_cases.description: Turn common tickets into FAQs and troubleshooting steps that users can follow independently.

use_cases.title: Build a Tutorial Library
use_cases.description: Plan beginner tutorials with goals, prerequisites, visual checkpoints, and related follow-up guides.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Quick Start
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a quick-start guide for [product]. Include account setup, profile setup, first project creation, screenshots to capture, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Task How-To Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a how-to guide for [task] in [product]. Include prerequisites, numbered steps, expected result, troubleshooting, and related guides.

prompt_templates.title: Structured FAQ Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert support questions into organized help content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an FAQ for [product] using these questions: [questions]. Group them by topic and keep answers short, direct, and user focused.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Documentation Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan a complete guide package for a product area.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a documentation set for [product area]. Include a quick start, three how-to guides, two tutorials, one FAQ, image needs, and maintenance notes.

output_examples.input: A product team needs onboarding help for a new dashboard feature.
output_examples.output: A quick-start guide with setup steps, dashboard creation, widget placement, screenshot notes, next steps, and support links.

output_examples.input: A support team has repeated questions about exporting account data.
output_examples.output: A how-to article with prerequisites, privacy settings navigation, export request steps, email expectations, download steps, and troubleshooting.

output_examples.input: A documentation lead wants a clear FAQ for account and billing topics.
output_examples.output: A grouped FAQ page with short answers for email changes, free plans, cancellation, collaboration, file formats, and security.

best_practices: Provide current product names, user roles, UI labels, and known support issues.
Add real screenshot names and review every step against the live product.
Keep each guide focused on one user goal and one expected outcome.
anti_patterns: Do not publish placeholder product names, links, or images without review.
Do not mix administrator setup, developer details, and beginner user tasks in one guide.
Do not rely on long paragraphs when numbered steps or screenshots are clearer.

faq.question: What type of documentation does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates quick-start guides, how-to articles, tutorials, FAQs, and documentation structure suggestions.

faq.question: Can it write for non-technical users?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill emphasizes simple user language, numbered steps, screenshots, and short explanations.

faq.question: Does it generate real screenshots?
faq.answer: No. It can mark where screenshots belong, but you must provide or capture the images.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.

faq.question: What input improves the output quality?
faq.answer: Provide product names, target users, UI labels, task goals, existing help links, and known support questions.

faq.question: Should the output be reviewed before publishing?
faq.answer: Yes. Review every step against the live product and replace placeholder examples before publishing.
